description_en: Queries the scope of users to whom a control policy applies
description_zh: 获取指定控制策略生效用户范围
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost get-policy-user-scope --instance-id bastion-xxxx-xx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --policy-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetPolicyUserScope

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the bastion host to which the control policy to query belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the ID of the bastion host
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the bastion host to which the control policy to query belongs.

For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the control policy that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html operation to query the control policy ID
parameters.help_zh:
指定要查询的控制策略ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2758876.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: policy_id

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

UserScope.description_en: The users to whom the control policy applies
UserScope.description_zh: 控制策略生效的用户范围

ScopeType.description_en:
The scope of users to whom the control policy applies.

If All is returned for this parameter, the control policy applies to all users.

If no value is returned for this parameter, the control policy applies to the assets specified in the return values of UserGroupIds and UserIds
ScopeType.description_zh:
控制策略生效的用户范围。

返回 All 时表示策略针对所有用户生效。
返回空值表示策略对指定用户生效，具体生效范围为UserGroupIds和UserIds的返回值

UserGroupIds.description_en: The user groups to which the control policy applies
UserGroupIds.description_zh: 控制策略生效的用户组范围

UserIds.description_en: The users to whom the control policy applies
UserIds.description_zh: 控制策略生效的用户范围
